title: 亚托克斯·核心素描
description: 角冠暗裔双手扶住静置大剑，赤黑双翼分列两侧，硬朗炭笔排线衬出甲面与剪影。

art_direction.medium: hand-drawn graphite and charcoal, confident pencil contours, cross-hatching, sculptural chiaroscuro and visible pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Aatrox is a towering Darkin with crimson and charcoal armor-like surfaces, a sharply horned head, luminous eyes, powerful adult humanoid proportions, and immense batlike wings. Preserve his elongated facial structure, imposing shoulder silhouette, and integrated fully covering armored body. His distinctive enormous dark-red greatsword is held vertically with its tip resting on stone, completely inactive.
art_direction.scene: Use a low three-quarter viewpoint, a calm upright posture and a broad diagonal shadow; let the lower peripheral lines fade into the paper. Build the composition specifically around this champion's defining anatomy, iconic motif and necessary companion. Use one faint environmental cue belonging to this character, and leave the rest as open sketch paper.
art_direction.palette: crimson, charcoal violet, copper rim light, pale stone
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
